title: PostCard on Home: hard-coded Chinese strings, zh-only relative time, emoji visibility markers instead of lucide icons
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/feed/post-card.tsx:28-32 (Globe/Users/Lock icon before time), 58-64 (date-fns locale-aware), 84 (aria tC('delete')), 124 (PhotoLightbox.counter aria), 158 (Comments.toggle); page.tsx:90-101 (confirm title Common.delete, message = post text snippet)
current_ios: The delete Alert uses literal '刪除貼文' / '確定要刪除這篇貼文嗎？此動作無法復原。' / '取消' / '刪除' / '刪除失敗' / '請稍後再試。'. a11y labels '刪除貼文', '留言' and '照片 N' are hard-coded. Visibility shows 🌍/👥/🔒 emoji after the time, where web shows a 12px lucide icon before it. relativeTime always renders Chinese ('剛剛', 'N分鐘前'), so the English locale sees Chinese timestamps on every Home post.
target: All copy comes from the shared catalog, matching web's iconography.
fix_plan: post-card.tsx: replace VISIBILITY_ICON with lucide-react-native components {public: Globe, friends: Users, private: Lock} and render `<View style={row gap 4}><VIcon size={12} color={colors.ink3}/><Text style={styles.meta}>{relativeTime(...)}</Text></View>`. Delete Alert: Alert.alert(t('Common.delete'), post.text ? post.text.slice(0,80) : t('Feed.deleteConfirm'), [{text: t('Common.cancel'), style:'cancel'}, {text: t('Common.delete'), style:'destructive', …}]). Failure: Alert.alert(t('Comments.deleteFailed')). a11y: Trash accessibilityLabel t('Common.delete'); comment toggle t('Comments.toggle') plus accessibilityState {expanded: commentsOpen}; photo t('PhotoLightbox.counter', {current: i+1, total: photos.length}). format.ts relativeTime: switch to new Time.* keys (below) via t(), or use Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(getLocale()) if Hermes in this build supports it (verify on device). This overlaps with the FEED surface, so coordinate to fix it once.
needs_new_i18n_keys: Feed.deleteConfirm = 確定要刪除這篇貼文嗎？此動作無法復原。 | Delete this post? This can't be undone.
verdict_reason: Verified. iOS post-card.tsx:71-87 has a hard-coded zh Alert ('刪除貼文', '確定要刪除…', '取消', '刪除', '刪除失敗', '請稍後再試。'). Also hard-coded: a11y labels '刪除貼文' (:104), '留言' (:154) and `照片 ${i+1}` (:217), and emoji visibility markers after the time (:29-33,99). format.ts:27-38 relativeTime is zh-only. Web post-card.tsx:28-32,57-64,73-76,83,120-123,157 uses lucide Globe/Users/Lock before a locale-aware date-fns time and i18n a11y labels. All the reuse keys exist (Common.delete/cancel, Comments.toggle, Comments.deleteFailed, PhotoLightbox.counter), and Feed.deleteConfirm and Time.* do not. One plan detail is wrong: apps/ios/src/lib/i18n.ts exports `activeLocale`, not getLocale(). format.ts:1-4 already notes that Hermes ships without full Intl, and Hermes does not implement Intl.RelativeTimeFormat, so the Intl alternative should be dropped.
corrected_fix_plan: As proposed, but implement relativeTime only with the new catalog keys via t() (Time.justNow, Time.minutesAgo {n}, Time.hoursAgo {n}, Time.daysAgo {n}) and keep the M/D fallback after 7 days. Do NOT use Intl.RelativeTimeFormat. If a locale branch is ever needed, import `activeLocale` from @/lib/i18n. relativeTime is also used by comments/feed, so the change fixes those surfaces too. Coordinate with the FEED audit so it is changed once.

title: No guest gating anywhere in iOS feed (compose, reactions, comments, report menu)
web_ref: apps/web/src/app/app/feed/page.tsx:98-110 (compose hidden + GuestLockedNotice feature=post), :119-126 (EmptyState CTA hidden for guests); apps/web/src/components/feed/post-card.tsx:88 (!isGuest gate on PostMenu), :142-143 (GuestLockedNotice feature=reactions replaces reactions+comments row); post-composer.tsx:175 (open && !isGuest)
current_ios: Anonymous (guest) users see the compose button, reaction controls, comment toggle and the ⋯ report/block menu. firestore.rules isRealUser() denies all posts/comments/reactions writes for sign_in_provider==anonymous, so every tap ends in a permission-denied failure, and the composer shows the raw error message.
target: Match web: guests can read the feed but get a locked notice in place of compose, and another in place of the reactions/comments row. The ⋯ menu is hidden for guests.
fix_plan: 1) Create apps/ios/src/components/feed/guest-locked-notice.tsx: a row in a card (colors.brandTint bg, hairline border, radius.sm 8, padding 16) with lucide Lock 16 + Text t(`Guest.locked.${feature}`) + a primary <Button size="sm" label={t("Guest.upgradeCta")}> that does router.push("/(tabs)/settings"), where GuestUpgradeSection lives. Alternatively, extract the upgrade handler from guest-upgrade-section.tsx into a hook and call it directly. 2) feed.tsx: const isGuest = !!user?.isAnonymous; hide the compose button when isGuest and render <GuestLockedNotice feature="post"/> under the header; hide the EmptyState CTA too. 3) post-card.tsx: if isGuest, render <GuestLockedNotice feature="reactions"/> instead of the actions row and CommentSection, and do not render PostMenu (the condition becomes !isAuthor && !isGuest). 4) post-composer.tsx: return null / visible={visible && !user?.isAnonymous} as a defensive guard. The PostCard fix also covers the home tab feed (app/(tabs)/index.tsx:60).

title: Unbounded feed rendered with .map inside ScrollView (up to ~90 cards, each firing a reaction read)
web_ref: apps/web/src/lib/firebase/posts.ts:189-210 (listFeedPosts merges mine+public+friends, each capped at 30, so up to 90 posts)
current_ios: All posts mount at once inside a ScrollView. Each PostCard mounts EmojiReactions, which does one getDoc for the user's reaction, and each card decodes its full-size images. Up to about 90 Firestore reads and image decodes run on open and again on every refresh.

fix_plan: Convert to <FlatList data={posts} keyExtractor={p=>p.postId} renderItem={({item})=><PostCard .../>} ItemSeparatorComponent={()=> <View style={{height:spacing.md}}/>} contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll} ListHeaderComponent={header from FEED-2} ListEmptyComponent={EmptyState from FEED-3} refreshControl={<RefreshControl .../>} initialNumToRender={5} windowSize={7} removeClippedSubviews keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"/>. Wrap PostCard in React.memo and memoize the onOpenPhotos/onDeleted callbacks with useCallback (removePost and removeBlockedAuthor in feed-data.ts are recreated every render, so wrap them in useCallback as well).

title: Reaction main-button tap switches a non-❤️ reaction to ❤️ instead of removing it
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/feed/emoji-reactions.tsx:135-138 (commit(mine ? null : DEFAULT_EMOJI))

title: Reaction counts never re-sync from props after pull-to-refresh
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/feed/emoji-reactions.tsx:58-60 (useEffect setLocalCounts(counts) on prop change)
current_ios: counts is only seeded from initialCounts in useState. A refresh keeps the same postId key, so the card does not remount and the new post.reactionCounts are ignored. Other users' reactions never appear until the screen is left.
target: Local counts follow fresh server counts whenever the post prop changes (and no write is pending).
fix_plan: Add useEffect(() => { if (!busy) setCounts({...emptyCounts(), ...(initialCounts ?? {})}); }, [initialCounts]). Also re-run getMyReaction when the post refreshes, by including initialCounts identity in that effect's deps or by keying on a refresh token.

Remove borderWidth from mainBtn/moreBtn (web has none; bg zinc-100 maps to colors.bgAlt). Close the tray when any other card control is pressed: a transparent full-card Pressable behind it, or onBlur via onStartShouldSetResponder at the card level. Also bump delayLongPress to 450 to match the web LONG_PRESS_MS. The card must not clip the tray, so check overflow on the post-card container.

title: Comment delete has no confirm, failures are silent, and the report menu is hidden on others' comments on your own post
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/feed/comment-section.tsx:164-183 (askConfirm title Comments.deleteTitle, message text.slice(0,60), confirm Common.delete, cancel Common.cancel, danger; rollback + Comments.deleteFailed), :231-251 (delete button AND PostMenu both render when c.authorUid !== currentUid)
ios_ref: apps/ios/src/components/feed/comment-section.tsx:138-149 (remove: no confirm, silent rollback), :182-201 (canDelete ? Trash : PostMenu)
current_ios: Tapping the 13px trash deletes immediately and permanently, with no confirmation. A failed delete rolls back silently. When the viewer is the post author, other people's comments show only the trash icon, so the viewer cannot report or block a commenter on their own post (UGC Guideline 1.2 path missing).
target: Destructive confirm before delete, an error message on failure, and both delete and the ⋯ menu shown for others' comments when the viewer may delete them.
fix_plan: In remove(): Alert.alert(t("Comments.deleteTitle"), c.text.slice(0,60), [{text:t("Common.cancel"),style:"cancel"},{text:t("Common.delete"),style:"destructive",onPress: async()=>{...existing optimistic delete...; catch → setError(t("Comments.deleteFailed"))}}]). Change the trailing slot to render the delete control when canDelete AND, independently, <PostMenu .../> when c.authorUid !== currentUid, so both can show. Move both into the meta line under the bubble, as in FEED-10.

title: Partial photo-upload failure leaves the composer open and never refreshes the feed (risk of duplicate posts)
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/feed/post-composer.tsx:155-166 (err.partial → onCreated() + show warning + auto-close after 1800ms); apps/web/src/lib/firebase/posts.ts:117-127 (attaches .partial)
ios_ref: apps/ios/src/lib/posts.ts:114-120 (throws plain Error, no partial marker); apps/ios/src/components/feed/post-composer.tsx:128-134
current_ios: When some photos fail, the post doc IS created, but iOS throws a plain Error. The composer shows the message, stays open with the draft intact, and never calls onPosted. Tapping 發佈 again creates a second post.
target: Partial success is treated as success with a warning: the feed refreshes and the sheet closes.
fix_plan: posts.ts: build `const err = new Error(...) as Error & {partial?: string}; err.partial = ref.id; throw err;`. post-composer.tsx catch: if ((err as {partial?:string}).partial) { onPosted?.(); setError(err.message); setTimeout(onClose, 1800); } else setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : t(...)). For a generic fallback, reuse Photos.status.failed or add Post.publishFailed. The posts.ts error strings themselves are Chinese literals (same as web), so leave them for parity.

title: Lightbox save: no busy state (double-tap saves duplicates), text glyph instead of lucide Download, wrong success copy, hard-coded labels
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/ui/photo-lightbox.tsx:341-370 (download action: actionBusy guard + disabled + Download icon + busyLabel), :379 (aria PhotoLightbox.close); apps/web/src/components/ui/save-to-album-button.tsx (Common.saveToAlbum.label/saved/failed)

current_ios: The lightbox supports a `saving` prop, but feed.tsx never passes it, so rapid taps start several downloads and saves and duplicate the photo in Camera Roll. The icon is a text arrow. Success shows "已完成 1 張照片。" (bulk-gallery copy), and labels are hard-coded. (Save in the feed lightbox is an accepted iOS-only extra; web's feed passes no downloadAction.)
target: Busy-guarded save with the lucide Download icon (Loader while saving), Common.saveToAlbum copy, and i18n a11y.
fix_plan: Inside PhotoLightbox, own the busy state: const [busy,setBusy]=useState(false). Make onSave return a Promise, and in onPress do if(busy) return; setBusy(true); try{await onSave(...)} finally{setBusy(false)}. Render busy ? <ActivityIndicator color="#fff"/> : <Download size={20} color="#fff"/>. Use accessibilityLabel t("Common.saveToAlbum.label"), and t("PhotoLightbox.close") for X. In feed.tsx (and the home tab), alert t("Common.saveToAlbum.saved") on success and t("Photos.status.failed") on failure. Match web button bg rgba(0,0,0,0.4) instead of white/15.

title: Lightbox: no tap-backdrop-to-close, dots style differs, counter not via i18n, dismiss animations ignore reduced motion
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/ui/photo-lightbox.tsx:273-282,318-327 (tap on dark margin closes), :392-436 (counter PhotoLightbox.counter 12px 80% opacity; dots h-2, active w-5 bg-mango-brand pill, inactive w-2 white/40, tappable with prev/next labels), :251-256 (reduced motion → no transitions)

current_ios: Only the X or a swipe-down closes the lightbox; tapping the black area does nothing. The active dot is a slightly larger white circle rather than a 20x8 mango pill. Dots aren't tappable. Under Reduce Motion, the modal fade and the drag-dismiss timing and spring still animate.
target: Web parity on dismiss affordance and indicator, and a full reduced-motion guard.
fix_plan: Add Gesture.Tap().onEnd(()=>runOnJS(onClose)()) composed via Gesture.Exclusive(pan, tap) on the track; or put a Pressable behind each image with onPress=onClose, using a contain-sized image so taps outside the image hit it. Counter: t("PhotoLightbox.counter",{current:index+1,total}) in 12px/500 at opacity 0.8. Dots: {height:8,width:8,borderRadius:4,backgroundColor:"rgba(255,255,255,0.4)"}, active {width:20,backgroundColor:colors.brand}. Wrap each dot in a Pressable (hitSlop 8) that sets the index and translateX, with a11y PhotoLightbox.prev/next. Reduced motion: animationType={reduceMotion?"none":"fade"}, and use duration 0 for the close/return timings when reduceMotion.
